document: H5C M01 preregistration: a same-quarter, same-cash, same-supply controlled-state transplant that compares three carried reference histories under one identical one-quarter cut.  The design replaces the legacy 1961Q1-versus-1967Q1 cross-year comparison.  The historical status stays UNIDENTIFIED; no D14 series is admitted.

legacy_card.hypothesis: consecutive consumption improvement raises the political cost of a later welfare/real-income cut nonlinearly, so an equal cut provokes a larger response after a long improvement run than early in the window.
manipulated_variables: policy.welfare_provision one-shot cut of equal size applied at 1961Q1 vs 1967Q1
policy.consumer_import_factor as a second real-income lever
controlled_variables: external history and the intervention files
legacy_card.falsification_criterion: the late cut's response in the grievance/consumption metrics is not larger than the early cut's by the declared margin.

revised_design.reason: the legacy card compares 1961Q1 with 1967Q1, so calendar quarter, cash, supply, external history and the remaining policy vector are not held fixed; the observed difference cannot be attributed to the carried improvement history.
revised_design.replacement: controlled-state transplant do(memory) on the p04_replay F1/Intermediate-8 synthetic structure at one treatment quarter.

synthetic_experience_inputs.rule: realized acquisition per channel = initial household_consumption_reference * e/(1-e)

metrics.zero_policy: a numeric zero requires a real non-empty row; empty/missing tables are failures

float_detection.note: numeric zero detection only; not an economic minimum effect

metrics.p_values: not computed and cannot promote a historical claim

statistics.main_contrast_D: R(four_steps) - R(one_jump), reported for the first treatment quarter and the four-quarter cumulative
statistics.replicates_note: three paired seeds are an engineering bank, not a power calculation

promotion_bar.matching: required exact same-point matching and whitelisted delta
promotion_bar.history: UNIDENTIFIED without an admitted D14 source
